mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days when the rate is below 5.0%.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS < 5.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate profit expectations and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5 (p-value > 0.05 for positive return rate).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures above 1800 and 360000 respectively indicate robust consumer demand, driving corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both HOUST > 1800 and RSAFS > 360000.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, rising industrial production signals overcapacity and potential inflation, prompting central bank tightening that reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in late-cycle expansion periods.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index exceeds 200, it indicates accelerating inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 200 (p-value > 0.05 for positive return rate).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending power and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE < 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in GDP and industrial production above 11300 and 110 respectively indicates strong economic expansion that fuels corporate earnings and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 > 11300 and INDPRO > 110.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly payroll employment growth exceeds 135,000 persons, it signals a robust labor market that increases consumer spending power and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of instances when PAYEMS > 135000 (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate).
